mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity cash flows and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is low are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 8.0 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 740.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 400000.0 signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 740.0 and RSAFS > 400000.0, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), a rise in the Federal Funds Rate above 0.15% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 0.15% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when PAYEMS is high are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 750.0 (thousands of units) signals a robust housing market, which supports consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 750.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST > 750.0 is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 96.0 and GDP (GDPC1) above 13500.0 signals robust supply-side economic growth, which supports corporate profitability and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 96.0 and GDPC1 > 13500.0, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 750.0 and RSAFS > 400000.0), a further increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 410000.0 signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In a housing boom regime (HOUST > 750.0 and RSAFS > 400000.0), 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 410000.0 (t-test p > 0.05).
